upstream.pathMapping: VENDORED skills/<name>/<rest>  ->  UPSTREAM <packages/shared-skills/skills | packages/omo-senpi/skills>/<name>/<rest>, with one exception: skills/ulw-execute/** comes from packages/shared-skills/skills/start-work/** (see renames[]). The two senpi skills (ultrawork, hyperplan) keep their own upstream package path because their content lives in packages/omo-senpi, not packages/shared-skills. Files[] entries carry an explicit `upstreamPath` whenever the mapping is not the identity, and every `modified` entry carries `upstreamSha256` = the upstream bytes at the tag (the R-8 two-way anchor).
upstream.license: SUL-1.0 (repository root LICENSE.md; the package manifest carries no license field)

package.name: @oh-my-opencode/shared-skills
package.note: The upstream package is harness-neutral content (markdown + reference files + scripts); only its skills/ tree is vendored here. `exports` / `types` / `files` are kept unchanged even though ./index.mjs and ./index.d.ts are not part of this copy (playbook M-3: dangling exports are recorded, not rewritten).

retainedLiterals.why: OMO runtime state path, not a reference to the skill's name. Renaming it would repoint an instruction at a ledger directory this project never creates; the carrier gap is already tracked by the omo-hooks H-32 port (phase 3, R-6). Carrier-narrowing notes deliberately do NOT go into skill bodies (phase4-plan.md §4.3).

Codex harness component path (the Stop/SubagentStop continuation hook), not a reference to the skill's name. Same reasoning as above; it is upstream provenance, kept verbatim so the body stays diffable against the tag.

deviations.why: The only field added; verified by diff against the tag (one added line). verify-licenses scores a missing license field as MISSING/FAIL, and the license that actually applies is the OMO repository-root LICENSE.md, carried by the upstream package manifest's absence of the field. Upstream carries no `scripts`, so unlike hashline-core no `test:vitest` was added: the 7 *.test.ts files in this tree are SKILL PAYLOAD that run under Bun inside a user's project, not a test suite for this repo (see the vitest.config.ts exclude note).
